# LOUDNESS.md — measured loudness per cue (generated by tools/audio/preview.py)

M = max momentary K-weighted loudness over 100 ms (BS.1770 K filter; short SFX are too short for gated integrated loudness). Mix = M + manifest `vol_db` (relative level before bus volume). Δ = Mix − median Mix of the same bus. |Δ| > 6 dB is listed for review; roles may justify it.
